More About the 2019 Toyota Camry

Toyota Camry Overview

In many ways, the Toyota Camry is the definitive family sedan. Its cabin is spacious and comfortable, and it comes with the amenities needed to keep its passengers connected and entertained. The Camry is sold with gas-only and hybrid powertrains, and the hybrid offers fuel economy that rivals that of the frugal Toyota Prius. The Camry is in its eighth generation as of the 2018 model year.

See Full Review

What's New on the 2019 Toyota Camry

Unchanged for 2019 after a complete re-haul last year.

Toyota Camry Pros & Cons

Pros

Powerful V6 engine. Great hybrid fuel economy. Standard adaptive cruise control and lane departure warning.

Cons

Some competitors have more cargo space. Missing Android Auto.

TrueCar’s used 2019 Toyota Camry inventory ranges from $1,909 to $99,000.
The used 2019 Toyota Camry comes in a sedan body style. 2019 Toyota Camry listings also offer automatic and manual transmissions. The 2019 Toyota Camry also comes with multiple fuel type options, such as gas and hybrid models.
The top used 2019 Toyota Camry trims based on nationwide inventory are the 2019 Toyota Camry SE with 2,764 listings, the 2019 Toyota Camry LE with 1,864 listings, and the 2019 Toyota Camry Hybrid LE with 1,587 listings. The average price for the 2019 Toyota Camry SE is $21,393, with the 2019 Toyota Camry LE and 2019 Toyota Camry Hybrid LE averaging $18,783 and $26,600 respectively.
Based on TrueCar’s inventory, used 2019 Toyota Camry listings usually offer Bluetooth, Backup Camera, and Premium Wheels. On the opposite end, only a small number of used 2019 Toyota Camry listings have Premium Audio, Front Cooled Seats, or Power Trunk/Liftgate.
The original MSRP for the 2019 Toyota Camry started at $25,050 for the L and went up to $35,805 for the XSE V6.
The 2019 Toyota Camry L gets a combined 34 MPG, per EPA estimate. The hybrid 2019 Toyota Camry Hybrid LE gets an estimated 52 MPG.
